academic_reviews.comment: Dr. Ahmed is an exceptional professor. His AI lectures are clear, well-structured, and always include real-world examples. He genuinely cares about students' understanding. Best professor I've had!
Great teaching style and very knowledgeable. Office hours are very helpful. Sometimes the pace is a bit fast but overall excellent course.
Truly inspiring! Changed my perspective on AI completely. The research opportunities he offers to students are incredible.
Very approachable and helpful. The course projects are challenging but you learn a lot from them.
Dr. Sara's software engineering course is the most practical course I've taken. Real industry practices, not just theory. She brings in guest speakers from top companies too!
Amazing professor! She really understands what the industry needs and teaches accordingly. Her code reviews are incredibly detailed and helpful.
Good teacher with high standards. The workload is heavy but you come out very well prepared.
Dr. Omar's database course completely changed how I think about data. The query optimization techniques I learned saved my current project from being unusably slow.
Knowledgeable professor but the exam questions could be clearer. Office hours are very helpful when you go.
Best database professor I've ever had. The hands-on SQL workshops are gold. I got my internship largely thanks to the SQL skills from his course.
Dr. Layla is pioneering medical informatics research at our university. Her passion for the intersection of medicine and technology is contagious. Highly recommend!
Brilliant doctor and researcher. The course gives a great overview of how AI is transforming healthcare.
Dr. Youssef's electrical engineering lectures are always perfectly organized. He never leaves a question unanswered and his lab sessions are fantastic.
Great professor, very patient with students. The exams are fair and reflect what was taught in lectures.

projects.title: AI Study Planner
projects.description: An intelligent study scheduler that uses ML to optimize your revision timetable based on exam dates, difficulty, and past performance. Built with React and Python/Flask backend.
